text:
Lina: Quick lab readout — 8/10 testers tapped the onboarding toast but were unclear what "Try demo" did. They expected to see a preview of the sample project's output before committing. Marco: Agreed. The toast is too fleeting. Propose an inline expandable preview (collapsed 1-line summary -> expand to show a 2-line output sample + small run button). Keeps discovery but shows value. Dana: Metrics note: prior experiments where we showed previews had ~12% higher complete rate. Tradeoff is header real estate. Suggest collapsed-by-default preview. A11yBot: Screen-reader guidance: if preview auto-expands announce with `aria-live="polite"` and label region `role="region" aria-label="Onboarding sample preview"`. Provide a skip link and ensure focusable Run button. Also check contrast for chips >=4.5:1. Example snippet for SR: ```
Sample output: "Hello, Redwood!"
``` Lina: Copy variants to test: "Run sample project" (explicit), "Preview sample" (neutral), "Try demo" (short). I vote explicit. Marco: Microcopy under the action: "No infra • 1 min" to set time expectation. Also show small icon for output type (chat / code). ExperimentBot: Experiment plan: A (toast-only), B (toast + collapsed preview), C (persistent inline preview). Track events: onboarding_toast_click, preview_expand, run_sample_click, onboarding_toast_dismiss. Hide toast for 14 days after dismiss. Dana: Engineering: ~4 dev days for MVP preview card + SR announcements + telemetry hooks. We can scope to a single sample with static snippet for rollout. Lina: Also propose keyboard shortcut `g o` to open onboarding panel for power users; include that in the tooltip. I'll create the ticket with Figma mock and a11y checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup: Marco: I'll attach compact mockups and SR copy notes to the ticket.
